title: Building Structural Design
description1: Structural concept, preliminary sizing and verification for new and existing buildings.
description: ETS Structure provides structural engineering studies for residential, commercial, industrial and public buildings, including load analysis, member design and coordination with architects and contractors.
pricing: Fees on request depending on drawings, project phase and complexity
Deliverables: calculation notes, assumptions and technical recommendations

title: Structural Calculations
description1: Reliable calculation notes for load-bearing members, connections and structural systems.
description: Design of beams, columns, slabs, foundations, load-bearing walls, frames and connections according to project assumptions and applicable standards.
pricing: Fixed fee or estimate after scope review

title: Structural Assessments and Diagnostics
description1: Analysis of cracks, defects, deformation and structural pathologies.
description: Inspection, document review, probable-cause analysis and repair or strengthening recommendations. Reports support technical and administrative decisions.
pricing: Site visit and report on request
Estimate depends on urgency, travel and investigation level

title: Bridges and Civil Structures
description1: Engineering studies and technical advice for bridges, footbridges, walls and special structures.
description: Support for civil structure projects: structural checks, capacity analysis, repair proposals, strengthening and technical follow-up.
pricing: Offer adapted to the structure type
Desk review or site visit possible

title: Infrastructure and Civil Engineering
description1: Structural support for infrastructure, foundations, retaining structures and buried works.
description: Civil engineering studies for infrastructure projects, building/infrastructure interfaces, retaining structures and structures exposed to specific ground or operating constraints.
pricing: Quote after review of constraints and available documents

title: Rehabilitation and Strengthening
description1: Solutions to transform, repair or increase the capacity of existing structures.
description: Strengthening studies for change of use, wall openings, extensions, additional floors or defect remediation, considering site feasibility and operating constraints.
pricing: Study quoted according to surveys, drawings and building condition

title: Technical Assistance and Project Review
description1: Independent advice to secure technical choices and project documents.
description: Review of calculation notes, constructive principles, variants, tender or execution documents, and support for technical questions from project stakeholders.
pricing: Short assignment or continuous support on request
